access_used: public sample in paper/repo/card only (full data needs BetterUp registration form; download links are emailed)
note: CANDOR media and transcripts are released only after a reviewed registration with emailed links, so these are the two transcript excerpts printed in the paper's figures; they show the same speech segmented by the corpus's turn models (Audiophile = raw speaker changes, Cliffhanger = sentence-bounded, Backbiter = back-channels moved to a side registry). The figures carry no timestamps, so timeline is empty. The unofficial HF derivative (hiraki/candor-turntaking-annotations) was checked and not used: its label columns are all empty and the transcripts in the sampled conversation are ASR hallucinations (e.g. 'wait, wait, wait…' repeated), not CANDOR's AWS transcripts.

raw.Backbiter rule (paper text p.30): (1) a back-channel turn must be three words or fewer; (2) a back-channel turn must contain >50% back-channel words (e.g., “yeah,” mhm,” “exactly”); and finally (3) a back-channel turn must not start with a prohibited word, such as “I'm…”.
